lines.en: You have a friend named Socko?
Yeah, he's the one who sells me all the cool socks.
She only liked me for my socks.
I even-- I even wore my fancy socks.
You're handsome, you're funny, you're smart, and you can cook.
Don't forget about my very special socks.
Um, blue stripes with golden pineapples?
Or aqua with fuchsia palm trees?
Look at you thinking outside the socks.
See, since he owns his own sock company,
I made his birthday cake in the shape of a sock.
This is incredible. How'd you do this?
I just combined my sculpting skills with my cakery skills
and boom, sock cake, shall we applaud?
